h1: Custom Etched Lapel Pins for Professional Branding
metaTitle: Custom Etched Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched lapel pins for a sleek, permanent brand mark. Perfect for corporate gifts and employee recognition at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etched lapel pins offer a refined, permanent design that won't fade or peel over time. The metal is chemically engraved, creating a subtle recessed detail that looks sophisticated on blazers and uniforms. Marketing directors often choose etched pins for long-term brand campaigns, while HR managers use them for service awards. The process works well on brass, zinc, or nickel, and you can add enamel fill for color contrast. These pins convey durability and attention to detail.
heroAltText: Custom etched lapel pins with metallic finish and engraved text, perfect for corporate branding and recognition awards.
